unlatched_review: No distinct protruding latch or lock bolt was found; the visible keyhole and long pull remain in the colliding Handle group.
modifications: Normalize the GLB with a proper rotation to canonical Z-up meters; preserve original frame and all materials.
Keep the measured 0.10149 mm moving-assembly recentering.
Uniformly scale Panel and Handle together by 0.996 about the original leaf center to introduce approximately 2 mm side clearance; no nonuniform deformation.

Place the inferred vertical hinge on the opening-face corner at the original right-hand edge, rather than the unsupported mid-thickness axis. This is a benchmark hinge assumption, not recovered real hardware.
Cook the solid leaf from all its material-separated surfaces together; do not inflate disconnected planar skins independently. Frame partitions and separate handle collisions remain active.
Use nominal closed-unlatched physics and derive the opening limit from the corrected collision geometry; no arbitrary angle cap.
clearance_review: The source leaf fills the jamb opening, leaving effectively zero side clearance. Uniformly reduce the complete moving assembly by 0.4% about the measured leaf center, retaining its shape and handle attachment: 1.9957 mm leaf side gaps, 1.8947 mm at the skewed hinge-edge skin, and 4.28 mm top clearance. This is an explicit simulation fitting repair, not a measured manufacturer clearance.

collider_groups.review: All Panel components are disconnected/material-separated surfaces of one solid rectangular leaf with shallow front decoration, not independent solids. Use their common convex envelope; retain all visual surfaces and separately collidable pull/keyhole hardware. This fills up to 6.35 mm decorative face grooves, while preserving the physical leaf envelope and eliminating invented thickness on planar skins.
